name: keydler
description: Keydler, a browser-local, human-supervised task memory that agents read and write over WebMCP

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && node scripts/precache.mjs && node scripts/headers.mjs
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && ALLOW_NO_ORIGIN_TRIAL=1 npm run build && ALLOW_NO_ORIGIN_TRIAL=1 npm run artifact && npm run links
scripts.build:trial: TRIAL=1 tsc --noEmit && TRIAL=1 vite build && node scripts/precache.mjs && node scripts/headers.mjs
